title: Receipts Applied to Transactions
description: Cash receipt applications to invoices and other transactions within an application date range, grouped by receipt.
sql:
SELECT acr.RECEIPT_NUMBER                         AS RECEIPT_NUMBER,
       acr.RECEIPT_DATE                           AS RECEIPT_DATE,
       arm.NAME                                   AS RECEIPT_METHOD,
       hp.PARTY_NAME                              AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
       hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER                         AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
       acr.CURRENCY_CODE                          AS RECEIPT_CURRENCY,
       acr.AMOUNT                                 AS RECEIPT_AMOUNT,
       rct.TRX_NUMBER                             AS APPLIED_TRX_NUMBER,
       rct.TRX_DATE                               AS APPLIED_TRX_DATE,
       rct.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE                  AS TRX_CURRENCY,
       ara.APPLY_DATE                             AS APPLY_DATE,
       ara.GL_DATE                                AS GL_DATE,
       ara.AMOUNT_APPLIED                         AS AMOUNT_APPLIED,
       NVL(ara.EARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN, 0)
         + NVL(ara.UNEARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN, 0)    AS DISCOUNT_TAKEN
FROM   AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL ara
JOIN   AR_CASH_RECEIPTS_ALL acr  ON acr.CASH_RECEIPT_ID = ara.CASH_RECEIPT_ID
JOIN   RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL rct   ON rct.CUSTOMER_TRX_ID = ara.APPLIED_CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
LEFT JOIN AR_RECEIPT_METHODS arm ON arm.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID = acr.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
LEFT JOIN HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS hca   ON hca.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = acr.PAY_FROM_CUSTOMER
LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES hp          ON hp.PARTY_ID = hca.PARTY_ID
WHERE  ara.APPLICATION_TYPE = 'CASH'
AND    ara.STATUS = 'APP'
AND    ara.DISPLAY = 'Y'
AND    TRUNC(ara.APPLY_DATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(:P_FROM_DATE) AND TRUNC(:P_TO_DATE)
AND    (:P_ORG_ID IS NULL OR ara.ORG_ID = :P_ORG_ID)
AND    (:P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER IS NULL OR hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER)
ORDER BY acr.RECEIPT_NUMBER, acr.RECEIPT_DATE, arm.NAME, hp.PARTY_NAME, hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ara.APPLY_DATE, rct.TRX_NUMBER
assumptions: Only receipt applications (APPLICATION_TYPE = 'CASH') with STATUS = 'APP'; unapplied, on-account and activity applications are excluded.
DISPLAY = 'Y' keeps the current application row, so applications that were later reversed or reapplied are not shown twice.
Date range filters the application date (APPLY_DATE), not the receipt date or GL date.
Customer is the receipt's paying customer (PAY_FROM_CUSTOMER); a receipt applied across customers shows under its payer.
AMOUNT_APPLIED is in the transaction currency; cross-currency applications may differ from the receipt currency.
